values: YOW November launch sprint — start here
Quiet release Sunday 1 November · public launch and marketing Monday 2 November

Every morning: spend 10 minutes (15 on weekends) copying today's prompt into Codex. AI handles code, terminal work, automated tests, documents, and evidence while you are at work or with your family.

Every evening: open the result and do only the guided owner task: clicks, decisions, real-device checks, or account-dashboard work.

Weekday: 10 minutes in the morning plus no more than 110 minutes in the evening. Most days are shorter.
Weekend: 15 minutes in the morning plus two blocks totalling no more than 3 hours 45 minutes. Absolute total: four hours.

When time is up, stop and mark In progress. Do not double tomorrow's work.
How to use the Daily Guide

1. Find today's row.
2. Copy its entire morning prompt into Codex before work.
3. In the evening, read Codex's result and your Owner instructions.
4. Follow one step at a time and report exactly what appears.
5. Set Status to Done, In progress, or Blocked and add a note.
6. Work in order. Never skip a failed hard gate.

Never paste passwords, API keys, recovery codes, or secrets into chat or this workbook. Use disposable data and designated test accounts. Stop when a screen differs from the instructions. Never test deletion or permissions with the owner/admin account. Real checkout stays off until the rehearsal passes.

31 October: rehearse; checkout stays off.
1 November: if every gate is green, deploy quietly, remove Beta as a public tier, stop new Beta grants, preserve existing testers' access and exports, enable checkout, and complete one real purchase. No ads.
2 November: verify overnight health, then announce and market.

A failed auth, data-loss, save, export, desktop, legal, payment, or release-candidate gate moves launch. That is a safety decision, not a personal failure. Record the evidence, stop safely, and let AI prepare the repair. Cosmetic polish and new ideas wait until after launch.

Apple Calendar: File → Import → choose YOW-November-Launch-Calendar.ics.
Google Calendar: Settings → Import & export → Import → choose the .ics file.
Outlook: Add calendar → Upload from file.

Weekdays: 7:30 AM handoff and 8:30 PM owner block. Weekends: 8:30 AM handoff plus two blocks. Times use Europe/London and can be dragged to fit your routine.
